recipe.title: Matcha Milkshakes {vegan}
recipe.description: In case you haven't noticed, I sort of have a thing for matcha. I know it's SO trendy... but I…
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened matcha* (or up to 1 tablespoon)
1 to 2 scoops vanilla ice cream (I used vegan coconut ice cream here, but use whatever you like.)
instructions: In a small bowl whisk your almond milk and matcha together. (Tip: If your matcha is lumpy, strain it with a tea strainer).
Pour your "matcha milk" into a jar, add ice cream. Shake. Let it soften a bit. Stir and enjoy!
